priorityList: Use Halo on cooldown as it is the primary trigger for Archon hero talents.
Cast Voidform (or Dark Ascension) once Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are active on your targets.
Use Power Infusion, ideally coinciding with Voidform or other major damage windows.
Cast Void Blast on cooldown as your top priority while Voidform is active.
Use Tentacle Slam to apply or refresh Vampiric Touch and deal heavy AoE damage.
Maintain Vampiric Touch on up to 12 targets, using Shadow Crash or manual applications.
Cast Void Torrent when your dots (Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain) are ticking on targets.
Use Shadow Word: Madness if you are close to capping Insanity or if its damage-over-time effect has expired.
Cast Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health to generate Insanity and trigger execute effects.
Cast Mind Blast to prevent charges from capping and to generate Insanity.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity whenever you have the proc available.
Use trinkets and combat potions during your Voidform and Power Infusion window for maximum benefit.
Use Mind Flay as a filler if all other high-priority abilities are on cooldown.
